name: @caiqueoak/flow
description: Readability-first, agent-agnostic software development workflow for coding agents.

scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node dist/entry.js schemas
scripts.test: npm run build && tsx --test src/commands/task/tests/*.test.ts src/commands/migrate/tests/*.test.ts src/package-assets/tests/*.test.ts
scripts.format: prettier --write .github src scripts skills docs AGENTS.md package.json package-lock.json README.md eslint.config.js prettier.config.mjs tsconfig*.json
scripts.format:check: prettier --check .github src scripts skills docs AGENTS.md package.json package-lock.json README.md eslint.config.js prettier.config.mjs tsconfig*.json
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run pack:check && npm run test:package
